description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called AgentEventsWindow that displays a list of agent events, with functionality to clear events and display formatted event details including JSON data and timestamps. It also includes a private view EventRow for individual event display and a preview provider for testing.

classes.name: EventRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a single event row, displaying event stream, run ID, timestamp, and JSON data in formatted style.

classes.name: AgentEventsWindow
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view displaying the list of agent events with controls.

methods.name: formattedTs
methods.description: Formats the event timestamp into a human-readable HH:mm:ss.SSS string.

methods.name: prettyJSON
methods.description: Converts a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values into a pretty-printed JSON string.
